page.overview:
Who is Boko?

Boko is a minor character in World of Final Fantasy, and is a Grymoirian incarnation of Boko originating from Final Fantasy V. Boko is one of the six character representatives of that game, the other five being Bartz, Faris, Syldra, Gilgamesh, and Enkidu.
